title: EscrowFinish
key_points: The EscrowFinish transaction type is used to finalize an escrowed payment.
It requires the public key of the account that will receive the funds, and the payment amount.
If the conditions are met, the funds are released from escrow to the receiver's account.
limitations: The documentation does not cover all possible edge cases or error handling.
It assumes familiarity with XRPL concepts and terminology.
The scope is limited to the standard behavior of an EscrowFinish transaction in a typical use case.
asserts: When all conditions are met, an EscrowFinish transaction releases escrowed funds from the payer's account to the receiver's account on the XRPL ledger.
scope: This section asserts what happens when an EscrowFinish transaction is issued under normal circumstances, without covering edge cases or error handling.
